mainEntity.name: How long does a typical nutrition coaching program last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a nutrition coaching program can vary based on individual goals and progress. While some clients achieve their initial objectives within 3-6 months, others may prefer ongoing support for longer-term maintenance or to address more complex habits. We offer flexible program structures that can be adapted to your needs, whether you're looking for short-term guidance or continuous accountability. Your coach will discuss a recommended timeline during your initial consultation based on your specific objectives and commitment to the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Program length varies, but many clients see results in 3-6 months. We offer flexible options for both short-term guidance and long-term support depending on individual goals.
